decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, and then bringing them back onto the battlefield with Reanimate. The key strategy is to combo off by using powerful reanimation targets like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Fatal Push to protect the combo and deal with opposing threats. The goal is to win the game through early aggression and graveyard shenanigans.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly using cards like Mishra's Workshop, Ancient Tomb, and Grim Monolith, to use powerful artifacts like Coveted Jewel and The One Ring to win the game. It also includes control elements like Force of Will and Tinker to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key concept is to assemble the combo pieces efficiently and protect them while building enough resources to overwhelm the opponent and claim victory.

This Esper Control vintage deck focuses on using various control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while drawing cards and generating card advantage. The deck utilizes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Swords to Plowshares to control the board and counter opponent's spells. The inclusion of Wasteland and Strip Mine helps disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Spell Pierce provide additional disruption. The deck also includes card draw spells like Dig Through Time and Treasure Cruise to keep the player's hand full and maintain control over the game.

The deck focuses on using powerful draw and tutor cards to assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game quickly. This includes using Underworld Breach to continuously recur spells from the graveyard and generate infinite mana through cards like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Hullbreacher to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With the ability to win in just a few turns, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to recover.

The deck revolves around utilizing the "Dredge" mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures and trigger powerful effects such as Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam. It aims to rapidly establish a board presence by constantly dredging through the deck with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation. Bazaar of Baghdad provides card selection and graveyard filling, while Hollow One and Narcomoeba offer additional threats to pressure the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly and efficiently bring back creatures and trigger powerful effects. It utilizes cards like Bazaar of Baghdad, Serum Powder, and Golgari Grave-Troll to fill the graveyard quickly, while also including cards like Ichorid, Narcomoeba, and Prized Amalgam to consistently bring creatures back onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, it incorporates cards like Creeping Chill and Hollow One to apply pressure and close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer. The deck also includes powerful mana acceleration with cards like Sol Ring, Ancient Tomb, and the Moxes to quickly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's mana base with Wasteland and Strip Mine. The goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan while advancing your own to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using artifacts to generate mana quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming aggression against the opponent. By combining cards like Mana Crypt, Grim Monolith, and Sol Ring with powerful artifacts like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator, the deck can establish a dominant board presence and quickly close out games. With additional support from cards like Defense Grid and Sensei's Divining Top, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while pushing forward with its powerful artifact creatures and game-ending combos.

The deck focuses on using efficient mana rocks and card draw spells to quickly assemble the Paradoxical Outcome combo, allowing the player to draw their entire deck and generate a massive amount of mana to win the game. It includes powerful restricted cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk, along with disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the game until the combo can be executed. The deck also includes some versatile sideboard options like Lurrus of the Dream-Den to adapt to different matchups and situations.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty, then bringing them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Unearth. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Grief and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and control the game. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to quickly execute its game plan of reanimating threats and overwhelming the opponent.

The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plays by taxing their spells with Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper and Seasoned Dungeoneer. It also includes Hatebear creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Witch Enchanter to disrupt the opponent's strategy further. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Strip Mine to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to both disrupt the opponent and apply pressure to win the game quickly.

The deck revolves around utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play early in the game, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Abrupt Decay to control the game and protect its key pieces. Show and Tell and Flash provide additional ways to cheat creatures into play, while Bolas's Citadel can generate card advantage and close out the game quickly. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a dominant board presence with its powerful creatures.

The primary focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and resource denial with cards like Force of Will, Fatal Push, and Wasteland. The deck aims to control the game tempo by utilizing card advantage with Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, while also applying pressure with Orcish Bowmasters and Psychic Frog. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value by allowing the player to recur valuable permanents from the graveyard. Overall, the deck excels in outsmarting and outlasting opponents through strategic decision-making and powerful card choices.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan by playing hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper and White Plume Adventurer. The inclusion of cards like Chalice of the Void and Disruptor Flute further hinders the opponent's ability to cast spells, while cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland disrupt their mana base. The deck aims to control the game through disruptive creatures and spells, while also presenting a fast clock with aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while putting pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent, paired with powerful aggro creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Witch Enchanter, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Additional disruption comes from cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck also has access to powerful artifact accelerants like Black Lotus and Moxen to help ramp out threats early in the game.

The main focus of this Vintage 1 vs 1 deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Stinkweed Imp and Ichorid, and then bring them back onto the battlefield with cards like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. Using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to manipulate the graveyard, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and disrupt their game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Force of Negation. The deck also has ways to gain incremental advantage and close out the game quickly with cards like Creeping Chill and Hollow One.
